text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Which shaved ice flavor to pick～♪ Summer vibes,
so pineapple? Kiwi sounds super fun too～

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aww, all look yum! Trainer-san,
gonna go check menu up close!

At summer training camp with Smart Falcon.
Off-day today, training routine had gone
smoothly, until―

text_block_list.name: Dirt Aptitude Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Haa～…… summer camp finally here, but
dirt, dirt, dirt…… non-stop dirt everywhere……

Heard heavy sigh. Looked over, spotted lonely Uma
Musume poking at dirt track. Looked familiar……

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, I'm back☆ Went with
electrifying Hawaiian Blue today♪

――Smart Falcon returned,
headed off to grab shaved ice together.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew～……! Feeling refreshed!
Must be power of shaved ice――

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
……Hm? What's going on?
Looks like crowd forming over there.

Went over with Smart Falcon
to investigate crowd. Arrived to find―

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: What do I do, what do I do……?

Rookie trainer panicked; several trainers
and Uma Musume had gathered around,
drawn by frantic shouts.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ……Wonder what happened.

As noted, details unclear.
Decided to ask trainers nearby.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
D-disaster……! Trainee hasn't
returned, break ended ages ago……!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Can't reach her phone either.
Sun setting fast too. Might be lost……

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No way……! Need to find her ASAP!
Right, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we want to help find her
Yeah, we want to help find her

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Right, standing around helps nobody. Let's split
up search. Any hunch where she might've gone?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you……! Umm, maybe―

Search sectors assigned, full search began.
Assigned zone was―

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Far side of beach, huh.
Hardly anyone around here……
choice_data_list: That doesn't mean she isn't here
That doesn't mean she isn't here

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, happens easily.
Wandered off on walk and lost path.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aaaalright! This is our zone, time for full power
search! Falco checks far end! Total pro at
sand sprints-!

Smart Falcon fired up, dashed off
into distance before could stop her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haa…… Haa…… Haa……!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Over here? Or maybe there?
Uuu…… dashed out blindly, totally lost track)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Gave word though, gotta give 100%……!
Full Throttle☆Max Power! Falco, gooo!)

text_block_list.name: Dirt Aptitude Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Eh, Falco-san……?
Why sprinting out here……?

Walked perimeter extensively afterwards,
neither missing girl nor Smart Falcon in sight.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Any luck over here……?
Searched all beach, zero sign……

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I see……
Damn it, where to search next……?

Time slipped away without leads. Had to
find her before sunset. Just as worry mounted―

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sorry・To・Keep・You・Waiting——————!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Landing right in your heart☆ Catch her on run♪
Number one Umadol, Smart Falcon☆

Covered in dirt from extensive dash.
……Trailing behind was missing girl.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san!
Supposed to chant "Falco!" right there, big foul☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe…… sorry for worrying you.
Just thought "Full power!" and bolted
without thinking.

Missing trainee had been hopelessly lost.
Found solely thanks to Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Done changing clothes, already night……
Wanted to sneak in tiny bit more practice.

text_block_list.name: Dirt Aptitude Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Falco-san…… hey!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah, huh, what?
―Oh! You're……

text_block_list.name: Dirt Aptitude Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Waved flags together back then……! Got
dirt aptitude too…… always hated accepting
that about myself.

text_block_list.name: Dirt Aptitude Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Watching Falco-san today…… first time thinking
"Dirt isn't bad at all!" Seeing Falco-san blaze
through sand, completely sparkling……!
Thanked Smart Falcon and ran off.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
…………
……Her eyes were totally shining, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Falco with eyes like that……
―Ehehe, gained new fan maybe?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Performers giving everything and shining, fans
basking in that light together, I think!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Soooo amazing, right? Falco wants to
shine bright for everyone too♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As long as you give 100%, role doesn't
matter, huh? ……Alright! Celebrating birth of Fan #2♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Unveiling ultra-cute, radiant smile♪
Top tier Umadol～, Smart Falcon☆

Dedicated once goal set.
Reliable and brilliant―

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
――Come on, Trainer-san! Cue word was "Cute!" right?
Okay, retry! Do-over time～～!
